name: Aegis Vigilate
text: Every model in the bearer's unit (an attached bodyguard included) gets +1 Toughness and a 4+ invulnerable save.

effect.name: Aegis Vigilate
effect.text: The bearer's unit has +1 Toughness and a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Aliens' Bane
text: The bearer's melee weapons gain [PRECISION], and each melee attack the bearer makes adds 1 to its wound roll. Bodyguard models are unaffected.

effect.name: Aliens' Bane (Precision)
effect.text: The bearer's melee weapons have Precision.

effect.name: Aliens' Bane (wound roll)
effect.text: Melee attacks by the bearer add 1 to the wound roll.
